title: Serial 2-bit comparator FSM (a vs b, MSB-first)
problemDescription: Sticky serial comparator FSM. ab(0)=a-bit, ab(1)=b-bit, MSB-first. Three states (equal, a>b, b>a). Once we have evidence one side leads, the FSM stays there unless the other side gets a decisive bit. o reports current verdict: 00=equal, 10=a wins, 01=b wins.
